premises.text: Finding and sharing useful information while texting requires leaving the message for fragmented searches across Google, maps, and many apps
premises.evidence_span: finding and sharing information while texting is challenging

premises.text: Deep-linked interactive logos inside messaging aggregate actionable place, brand, and people data so users can browse favorites and send rich info without typing
premises.evidence_span: Using deep linking, the Logee platform seamlessly provides aggregated data across a suite of services

premises.text: Logos are community-sourced worldwide and brands can claim profiles; Google integration creates instant logos when missing
premises.evidence_span: it's community sourced, which means that anyone can get involved and add logos

premises.text: Brands can sponsor logos for premium placement, branded content, integrations, and analytics as a new messaging marketing platform
premises.evidence_span: any brand, big or small, can create a holistic customer experience that extends into messaging

value.text: People get useful actionable information inside messaging via logos without leaving the chat
value.evidence_span: instant access to information inside of your messaging

secondary_value.text: Brands connect helpfully with consumers inside text messaging
secondary_value.evidence_span: people and brands connecting inside of text messaging in a helpful way
